newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS optimistic about Star Alliance.
newsitem.headline: SAS optimistic about Star Alliance.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) said on Monday it expected this year to see gains from its participation in the Star Alliance with Germany's Lufthansa and other airlines.

"Star Alliance is doing well and we see no reason why we should not see the expected effect. We can already this year start to feel the positive effect of joint purchases," SAS director Vagn Soerensen told Reuters.
SAS estimates its participation in Star Alliance to bring in 1.5 billion Swedish crowns in the year 2000.
In May SAS, Lufthansa, United, Air Canada, Thai Airways International and Brazil's Varig launched their global sales and operation alliance.
